title: Kind of People You Find in SIP Cafe Islamabad Part 1
body: The girl with a full nail art set that cost more than her order, holding the cup like it's a photoshoot prop, not a drink. The guy who parked his dad's Prado directly out front, hazards on, walked in slow enough for the whole outdoor seating to clock him. A university group not studying, just autopsying someone who isn't there, "no but like, she KNOWS what she's doing." An all-girls table mid boyfriend-slash-ex debrief, one of them "spilling the tea" just to keep the table interested, half of it invented on the spot. A guy who's already approached three tables today, opening with "so what do you do," closing with dad's business energy, accent doing something British that was never actually British.
caption:
Tag the friend whose accent gets British only at SIP 😭 Part 2 coming, who else do we need to expose
